reason: I like that they update prices by WhatsApp, that fixes exactly what went wrong with my last site. But €600 up front is more than a month of what I earn, for one apartment that already gets found on Facebook and WhatsApp.
objection: I already paid once for a website that died, and with one apartment I'm not sure a site brings enough extra bookings to earn back €600 plus €15 every month.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller one-apartment package around €300, or splitting the €600 into payments before the season starts.
